paragraphs: DMs, comments and captions — the casual English Indians actually use online, with do-and-dont tips.
Online English is relaxed but has rules.
lol (laughing), brb (be right back), idk (I don't know), tbh (to be honest), imo (in my opinion).
"Sunset vibes ☀️" works. Add a question to get replies: "Best beach near Mumbai?"
Write 3 casual messages on SpeakNow's text-to-speech to hear natural flow.
Casual English still needs correct basics. Don't drop grammar fully.
